newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products flat to stronger as crude support.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products flat to stronger as crude support.

text.p: NWE oil products were flat to stronger on Monday.
Gas oil was a tad stronger although easier heating oil barge premiums limited futures' gains of $1 a tonne. Diesel was still sought after, but cargo premiums were some 50 cents weaker.
Fuel oil was flat in a quiet market with barges trading at $83.25 and $83.50. The overall outlook remains bearish.

Gasoline was stronger in line with crude futures in an otherwise quiet market. A Eurograde barge traded at $194 fob ARA for first-half May delivery. Naphtha was steady in quiet trade as a sloppy Asian market continued to overshadow the market.
